type NumberIndexed<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T["a"];
type StringKey<T extends { "0": string }> = T[0];
type NumberKey<T extends { 0: string }> = T["0"];
type LeadingZero<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T["01"];
type Missing<T extends { a: string }> = T["b"];
type StringMember<T extends string> = T["nope"];
type ObjectKey<T extends object> = T["a"];
type BooleanKey<T extends [number]> = T[true];
type UnknownKey<T extends unknown> = T["a"];
type AnyKey<T extends any> = T["x"];
type Nested<T extends { a: number }, U extends T> = U["b"];
type UnionKey<T extends { a: 1 } | { b: 2 }> = T["a"];
